objective: Advance the Lorain MVP through three governed repository commits while the production cloud-change lane remains dark.
constraints: This slice cannot deploy, invoke AWS mutation APIs, alter production data, or publish schedules.
All repository writes occur only in the pre-created isolated VIA worktree and branch named in each commit contract.
Every builder is reviewed by a different role against the exact resulting commit.
No GitHub Actions, push, merge, grant issuance, or production activation is authorized by this document.
Unsupported, stale, blocked, or conflicting schedule facts remain explicit; no agent may type or invent parish times.
G08 Lorain launch approval and spend above 15000 cents per month remain human-only gates in the master roadmap.
Cloud change is a separate future capability and remains unavailable until its signed-approval lane passes independent adversarial review.
